productPatterns.name: Destination receipt
productPatterns.anatomy: Selected journey and audience stay visible beside capture; Only me is an explicit value
productPatterns.states: unknown journey, stale membership, offline
productPatterns.rule: No location inference; selecting a destination does not contribute

productPatterns.name: Capture controls
productPatterns.anatomy: Labelled Photo, Video, Voice, Text controls with a steady record/stop state
productPatterns.states: denied permission, interrupted, local saving, failed
productPatterns.rule: Capture confirmation follows durable local saving only

productPatterns.name: Transfer receipt
productPatterns.anatomy: Separate Local file, Private backup, Contribution, Publication eligibility rows
productPatterns.states: queued, transferring, finalizing, unknown, failed, missing file
productPatterns.rule: A transfer bar never stands in for publication or backup verification

productPatterns.name: Import inspection
productPatterns.anatomy: Selected file row plus metadata correction and explicit batch approval
productPatterns.states: unsupported, missing, duplicate, uncertain date/location
productPatterns.rule: Selection is not approval and not upload

productPatterns.name: Scope review
productPatterns.anatomy: Equal scope choices plus Current/Proposed comparison
productPatterns.states: mixed sources, stale permissions, narrowed grant, pending
productPatterns.rule: Original export remains a separate task

productPatterns.name: Original export grant
productPatterns.anatomy: Exact recipient, files and expiry with explicit approve/decline
productPatterns.states: expired, departed recipient, revoked, fresh identity required
productPatterns.rule: Membership and source reuse confer no export grant

productPatterns.name: Evidence note
productPatterns.anatomy: Source title, provenance, date, scope and return-to-passage
productPatterns.states: review-only, approved, withdrawn, no transcript
productPatterns.rule: Public projection contains approved accessible data only

productPatterns.name: Transcript correction
productPatterns.anatomy: Original wording and proposed correction together with source offset
productPatterns.states: unsupported language, processing, stale edit, offline
productPatterns.rule: Correction does not authorize publication or grant reuse

productPatterns.name: Stage and branch
productPatterns.anatomy: Named stage sequence and participant-specific branch labels
productPatterns.states: no GPS/rest day, gap, estimated, disputed
productPatterns.rule: Keep chapter, stage and source identities distinct

productPatterns.name: Practical observation
productPatterns.anatomy: Amount, currency, unit, party size and observation date beside evidence
productPatterns.states: estimated, conflicting, unknown, redacted
productPatterns.rule: A dated report is not current travel advice

productPatterns.name: Editor and insertion
productPatterns.anatomy: Readable chapter with source insertion tray and visible edit status
productPatterns.states: long text, source withdrawn, offline retained
productPatterns.rule: No drag-only ordering; source access checked again

productPatterns.name: Conflict comparison
productPatterns.anatomy: Current accepted text and retained candidate, with scoped resolution
productPatterns.states: stale again, rights lost, offline, evidence withdrawn
productPatterns.rule: No silent overwrite or automatic retry against a changed base

productPatterns.name: Publication blocker
productPatterns.anatomy: Affected source, exact dependent uses and authorized repair task
productPatterns.states: owner, coauthor, publisher-only, inaccessible evidence
productPatterns.rule: Repair controls are capability filtered; publisher authority is distinct

productPatterns.name: Exact candidate preview
productPatterns.anatomy: Candidate identity across Story, Explore, Learn and source inspection
productPatterns.states: building, ready, invalidated, failed, current publication
productPatterns.rule: Approval binds the reviewed candidate and current rights

productPatterns.name: Visibility approval
productPatterns.anatomy: Audience explanation and explicit designated-publisher approval
productPatterns.states: unlisted, public, draft changed, permission changed
productPatterns.rule: Catalog listing is a separate submission

productPatterns.name: Listing receipt
productPatterns.anatomy: Submission/status shown beside independent approved-publication state
productPatterns.states: not submitted, pending, listed, rejected, removed
productPatterns.rule: Listing rejection does not itself unpublish

productPatterns.name: Highlight selection
productPatterns.anatomy: Approved attributed sources, personal caption and full-journey disclosure
productPatterns.states: none eligible, withdrawn, generation failure
productPatterns.rule: Recipient is read-only; external copies cannot be recalled

productPatterns.name: Grounded answer
productPatterns.anatomy: Buffered answer, dated citations and a return to the exact source
productPatterns.states: sign-in required, abstention, quota, invalidation, provider failure
productPatterns.rule: No streaming internal reasoning or hidden-source citation

productPatterns.name: Lifecycle impact
productPatterns.anatomy: Exact object, rights impact and honest operation receipt
productPatterns.states: fresh identity, stale impact, unknown, cleanup pending
productPatterns.rule: No success until known; source owner retains safe access after departure

productPatterns.name: Invitation acceptance
productPatterns.anatomy: Named inviter/journey only when permitted and explicit Accept
productPatterns.states: signed out, wrong account, expired, already member
productPatterns.rule: Authentication preserves intent but never accepts automatically

productPatterns.name: Saved research
productPatterns.anatomy: Private note attached to a currently accessible reference
productPatterns.states: empty, unavailable reference, save failure
productPatterns.rule: Keep typed note on failure; scrub denied preview data

productPatterns.name: Safe unavailable
productPatterns.anatomy: Generic public recovery and neutral source-owner destination
productPatterns.states: withdrawn share/source, denied, missing, departed owner
productPatterns.rule: Do not leak private title, location, cover or member list

inventoryNote: shadcn 4.23.0 info detects Vite/Tailwind v4/Radix, but reports zero components because resolved alias paths include literal @. Direct file inspection establishes actual source presence. No CLI add/init/apply performed.
